messages:
Ajay (SRE): FYI postmortem follow-up from the 03/21 latency spike. We saw repeated short bursts causing p95 to hit ~1.8s (normal ~180ms). Proposing two short-term SLO adjustments and a remediation handoff: reduce cache TTL variance, add a circuit-breaker on heavy tail requests, and update dashboards to show burn-rate alerts.

Tara (Platform PM): Can you drop the dashboard links and the concrete SLO numbers you'd like to move? Need to share with sales/ops before we change SLAs.

Ajay (SRE): Dashboard: https://dash.redwoodinternal.com/d/9slo/latency-playback (panel id: latency-burn). Proposed temporary SLO tweak for next 2 weeks: p95 <= 300ms (was 200ms) for public hosted tier while we rollout fix. Error budget policy: pause aggressive automated rollouts if 7d burn-rate > 1.5.

Morgan (Eng-SRE): I can take ownership of the cache TTL variance remediation. Plan: 1) audit services with high TTL churn, 2) standardize to 60s/5m tiers, 3) ship config guardrails. Est ETA: 6 working days. Adding a small prefix/KV cache for hot routes as a fast mitigation.

Pat (Service Owner): For our throughput-sensitive endpoints, can we instead add a graceful degradation layer (reduced precision embeddings + rate-limited non-critical features) rather than loosening SLOs? That helps enterprise contracts.

Ajay (SRE): Agreed — we should prefer graceful degradation where possible. Action items I propose (short list):
- Ajay: Add burn-rate alert + playbook snippet to dashboard (today) :white_check_mark:
- Morgan: Cache TTL audit + config guardrails (6d)
- Pat: Define degradation policy for /embed and /search (3d)
- Tara: Communicate temporary SLO change to customer ops and sales (tomorrow)

Tara (Platform PM): I'll send a customer note template. Also want a follow-up sync on Mon to review metrics. Can ops-bot create a recurring SLO-check toggled for 2 weeks?

ops-bot: Created calendar event "SLO remediation checkpoint" for Mon 09:30 PT and recurring daily alert group for p95 burn-rate > 1.2.

Morgan (Eng-SRE): Added a quick PromQL query to the dashboard for anyone debugging:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service))
```
Use `service=redwood-inference` and `route=generate`.

Ajay (SRE): Also added a temporary canary fallback policy in routing with 2% traffic to cheaper quantized variants for affected model family. If error budget burn > 1.5 for 24h we expand to 10%.

Pat (Service Owner): I'll draft the degradation policy and list endpoints. Will sync with Morgan on the cache overlap.

Tara (Platform PM): Thanks — looks solid. Postmortem link and action tracker go in the playbook repo after we confirm owners. Expect update in this thread by end of day tomorrow.

Ajay (SRE): Noted. Quick note about dashboards: I added a new panel showing 'top N callers by p95' and CSV export so product can triage high callers. Ping me if you want access. :thumbsup:

Morgan (Eng-SRE): Received. Starting audit now, will post findings in the board.

Pat (Service Owner): I'll block time with sales for any impacted customers.

Tara (Platform PM): Closing the loop — follow-up sync Mon 09:30 PT. If anything changes DM me.
